name: The Lost Explorers
source: BigWigs (BigWigsMods/BigWigs) TheVenomousAbyss/Explorers.lua + Icy Veins boss guide (mechanics). Timings checked 24 Oct 2026 against Lorrgs.io (boss cast timelines of the top 50 Outlaw Rogue kills per difficulty, api2.lorrgs.io): see `checked` per difficulty.
notes: Edit freely (Fight settings > Edit…). Times are seconds after the start of the mechanic's stage. Stage starts come from the guide/BigWigs where noted, otherwise from a percentage of the fight length. timesFrom: bigwigs = timeline durations read from BigWigs (only ~the first minute or two of each stage is visible there), guide = from the Icy Veins guide, assumed = my guess. 'assumed' lists effect sizes that are guesses. Not modelled: tank/healer mechanics, raid damage, Bloodlust timing.

hazard.label: Mushroom Toss / Explosive Surprise / Mighty Thud / Frostfire Volley

fish.label: Carry the fish to a boss (feeding phase)

all.label: All difficulties
all.checked: Lorrgs 50 kills (Heroic median 180 s, Mythic 333 s): phase changes 61/121/176-184/230-244/306/366, i.e. every ~61 s (was 25 % of the fight); Blink Nova 17/48 in the first phase. Stage 4 timings repeat until the end.

council: Three bosses with separate health (Icy Veins: they do not share health). Two are kept together and cleaved; all three within 30 yd take 99 % less damage, so the third (Nama, rotating between them) is not in cleave range. Simulated as 2 targets for the whole fight.
